1. Getting started

Mr. Mars Music Studio All in 1 is a music production environment that runs in your browser. It combines multitrack recording, MIDI editing, a mixer, guitar and bass amp simulation, a DJ mixer, a tool that turns audio into notes, and a plugin system. It needs no installation, and once started it works without internet.

What you need

  • Computer: Windows or Mac with Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
  • For guitar or bass: an audio interface with an instrument (Hi-Z) input.
  • For MIDI keyboards and DJ controllers: Edge or Chrome. Safari has no MIDI.

Starting the app

DeviceHow to start
WindowsDouble-click Mr Mars Music Studio.cmd. The app opens in its own window with its own browser profile. Run Masaustu Kisayolu Olustur.cmd once to add a desktop and Start menu shortcut.
MacDouble-click Mr Mars Music Studio.command. If macOS blocks it the first time, right-click it and choose Open. See chapter 17.
Phone or tabletOpen the app's web address, then add it to the home screen. See chapter 17.

Your first five minutes

  1. Open File > Demo project to load a short example with drums, bass and chords.
  2. Press Space to play and stop. The ⟲ button repeats the marked loop region.
  3. Double-click a coloured clip to open it in the piano roll, and change a few notes.
  4. Open the Mixer tab and balance the tracks with the faders.
  5. Press Ctrl+S to save, then use Mixdown / Export to make a WAV file.

Separate windows

Any tab can open in its own floating window, so you can see two work areas at once. Use the ⧉ button on the tab name, double-click the tab, or right-click it and choose "Open in separate window". Most panels have their own ⧉ at the top right.

A floating window can be maximized, docked or closed from its title bar. When it closes, its content returns to its place. Window positions are remembered.

Language

The default language is English. On first start the app uses your browser's language if it is available, and English if it is not. To choose by hand, press the 🌐 button beside the menus. "Automatic" returns to the browser language.

3. Menus

File

  • New project: starts an empty project.
  • Demo project: loads the example project.
  • Save project (Ctrl+S): saves under a name inside the app.
  • Open saved project…: lists the projects saved inside the app.
  • Export project file (.mrmars)…: makes one file containing the project and its audio, for backup or sharing.
  • Open project file (.mrmars)…: opens such a file. Older .orbit files also open.
  • Import audio file… / Import MIDI file…: adds a file to the project.
  • Mixdown / Export WAV…: see chapter 16.

Edit

  • Undo, Redo: Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y.
  • Copy, Paste, Duplicate: Ctrl+C, V, D. These act on the selected clips.
  • Split at playhead: S cuts the selected clip at the playhead.
  • Delete: Del removes the selected clips.
  • Select all clips: Ctrl+A.

Track

  • Add audio track: for recording or importing audio.
  • Add instrument track: choose an instrument from the list. These tracks hold MIDI.
  • Add FX channel: a shared effect return that other tracks can send to.
  • Guitar track: an audio track with an amp and cab ready.
  • Bass guitar track: an audio track with a bass amp ready.

Tools

  • Audio settings: see chapter 16.
  • MIDI settings: MIDI Clock and connected ports.
  • Keyboard shortcuts: shows the list of shortcuts.
  • Storage: clean unused audio: deletes recordings that no project uses. It cannot be undone.
  • Add to home screen: appears where the browser supports installing the app.

Metal Creative

Quick access to the Metal Creative tools:

  • Open the tab.
  • Generate a random metal song into the project.
  • Create the mix template, empty or with an example song.
  • Add a metal guitar, bass, drum or industrial FX track.
  • Put DI Booster, Drum Fist or an archive tone on the selected track.

🌐 Language

Lists Automatic and the seven languages. A tick marks the current choice. The app reloads when you pick a language, so save your work first.

❓ Manual

Opens this manual in a new window. It is available in English, whatever language the app is using. The About window has the same link. When the app is installed, the manual also opens offline.

About

4. Arrange tab

This is the main workspace, where recordings and MIDI clips are placed along a timeline.

Toolbar

ControlFunction
+ Audio Track, + Instrument, + FX ChannelAdd a track of that type.
Import Audio File…Adds an audio file as a clip.
✂ SplitCuts the selected clip at the playhead.
GridSnap value: Off, 1 Bar, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 or 1/32.
ZoomHorizontal zoom. Ctrl + mouse wheel does the same.
Mixdown / ExportOpens the export window.

Track header buttons

ButtonFunction
MMute the track.
SSolo the track.
●Arm the track for recording.
eOpen the instrument panel (instrument tracks).
🎧Monitor the input for live playing (audio tracks).
AShow or hide automation lanes.
SliderTrack volume.

Working with clips

  • Move: drag a clip. Alt + drag copies it. Shift + drag ignores the grid.
  • Open: double-click a MIDI clip to open the piano roll.
  • Loop region: drag in the ruler.
  • Recording again over a clip keeps the old one as a muted take, so you can compare takes.

Right-click a clip for its menu. MIDI clips offer the items shown here. Audio clips add audio tools:

  • Split into stems: vocals, drums, bass and melody. The result is approximate.
  • Fit to tempo: changes the length and keeps the pitch.
  • Pitch shift: changes the pitch and keeps the length.
  • Reverse, normalize and fades.

Send to Session places the clip in the Session grid.

Automation lanes

Press A on a track to open its lanes. Each lane can control Volume, Pan or any parameter of a device on the track. Use "+ Automation lane" to add more.

  • Add a point: click empty space.
  • Move a point: drag it.
  • Delete a point: double-click or right-click it.
  • R (Read): plays the curve.
  • W (Write): records your control moves during playback.

Automation also applies to mixdown and stem export. The master channel and Amp Rack have no automation.

Piano roll

Left-click adds or moves a note, dragging the edge resizes it, and right-click deletes it. Ctrl selects several notes and the arrow keys move them. The lane at the bottom sets velocity.

ToolFunction
Grid, Clip lengthNote snap value, and clip length in beats.
Quantize (Q)Moves notes onto the grid.
+Octave, −OctaveMoves notes up or down an octave.
HumanizeAdds small timing and velocity changes.
LegatoExtends each note to the next one.
Scale, Lock to scaleHighlights a scale (major, minor, modes, pentatonic, blues, maqams) and keeps new notes on it.
Chord stampAdds a whole chord with one click.
Arpeggio, StrumTurns a selected chord into an arpeggio or a strum.
Chop (grid)Cuts notes into grid-sized pieces.

Inspector and devices

Select a track to see its details on the right:

  • Name and colour.
  • Instrument: "Open" shows its panel and "Change Instrument…" replaces it.
  • Insert Slots: effects in order. Use "+ Add Effect" to add one.
  • Sends: how much signal goes to each FX channel.
  • Channel: volume and pan.
  • Export track as WAV.

Drag a knob to change it. Right-click it for two options:

  • MIDI learn: turn a knob on your controller to link it.
  • Default value: resets the knob.

Effects

  • Distortion: Bitcrusher, Distortion / Saturation.
  • Dynamics & EQ: Multiband Compressor, Noise Gate, Compressor, Limiter, Parametric EQ, Pump.
  • Filter: Filter + LFO, Formant Filter.
  • Guitar & Bass: Amp Head, Amp Rack Rig, Dual Amp, Cabinet Simulator, Pickup Match.
  • Metal Creative: Drum Fist, DI Booster.
  • Modulation: AM / Ring / FM, Chorus, Rotary Speaker, Flanger, Auto Pan, Phaser, Tremolo.
  • Pedals: Clean Boost, Distortion, Fuzz, Graphic EQ, Compressor, Sub Octave, Overdrive, Wah.
  • Pitch and Performance: Pitch Shifter, XY Effect Pad.
  • Studio: FET and Opto Compressors, Cassette / Tape Machine, Saturator.
  • Space: Reverb, Shimmer Reverb, Stereo Width.
  • Utility and Time: Gain, Spectrum Analyzer, Delay.

Instruments

Analog Synth, Drum Machine, Sampler, FM Synth, Digital Mini Synth, Instrument Library, World Percussion, Metal Guitar DI, Metal Bass, Metal Drum Kit and Industrial Destruction FX.

5. Session tab

Session is a grid for launching clips live. Columns are tracks and rows are scenes.

  • Get clips here: right-click a clip in Arrange and choose "Send to Session".
  • Launch a clip: click it. It starts at the next launch point and loops.
  • Launch a scene: press ▶ in the Scene column to start that whole row.
  • Stop: ■ under a column stops that track. "■ Stop all clips" stops everything.
  • Launch quantize: 1 bar, 1/2 bar, 1 beat or Immediately.
  • Back to arrangement: returns playback to the Arrange timeline.
  • + Scene: adds a row.

6. Pattern Rack tab

A step sequencer. Each lit square plays a note on that step, and patterns are written to the arrangement as normal MIDI clips.

  • Click: turn a step on or off.
  • Shift + click: accent. Right-click: ghost note.
  • Click a row name: open it in the piano roll.
  • Pattern bar, ◀ ▶: the bar you are editing.
  • Steps: 16, 32 or 64. Swing: shuffles the timing.
  • ▶ Loop pattern: repeats the current bar.
  • Copy pattern to next bar: builds longer parts quickly.
  • + Channel (instrument): adds a new instrument row.
  • + on a drum row: shows all drum sounds. ⋯ at the row end: fill options.
  • Note menu on instrument rows: chooses the pitch of the row.

7. Mixer tab

From top to bottom, each channel strip has:

  • Name in the track colour.
  • Instrument (marked ♪) and insert effects. Click one to open it. + adds an effect.
  • Send knobs for each FX channel.
  • Pan knob.
  • Fader and level meter.
  • M, S, ●: mute, solo and record arm.

The demo project includes Reverb FX and Delay FX channels. Turn up a send on any track to feed them. The MASTER strip holds the final effects, such as the Limiter.

8. Mini Tools tab

XY Synth Pad

Horizontal position plays notes locked to the chosen scale. Vertical position controls the parameter chosen under "Y axis". It plays the selected instrument track, and "+ Mini Synth track" makes a new one. While recording, notes are written to the track, and Y moves can be written as automation with W. Gate Arp repeats the note in tempo while held.

XY Effect Pad

A live effect applied while you touch the pad: filter, delay, reverb, flanger, phaser, bitcrusher, pitch, gater or beat repeat. "Add to master output" places it on the master.

MIDI Tools

These act on all notes from MIDI keyboards, the computer keyboard, the on-screen piano, the XY pad and the pads.

  • Transpose and Snap to scale.
  • Chord: one key plays a whole chord.
  • ARP: arpeggiator with pattern, rate, octaves, gate and swing. Latch keeps it running after you release the keys.
  • Velocity: As played, Fixed, Soft or Hard.
  • Panic: silences all notes.

Looper (2 tracks)

Choose the length and source (master output, or audio input for mic or guitar). Press Record. When the loop wraps it moves to overdub or play, depending on the mode. ↶ and ↷ undo and redo layers. "Send to arrangement" turns the loops into clips. Length follows the project tempo, and track 2 locks to the loop of track 1.

Pad Controller

Sixteen pads that play the selected instrument. Hitting the top of a pad gives higher velocity. With Note Repeat on, a held pad retriggers in tempo at the chosen rate.

9. Re-Play tab

Re-Play turns a music file into notes and plays them with another instrument.

  1. Music file: drag in or choose an MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A/AAC, MP4/WebM or MIDI file.
  2. Convert to notes: set the options and press the button.
    • Analysis: Melody / riff for a single voice, or Polyphonic for chords.
    • Sensitivity, Quantize, Max voices.
    • Tempo: detect it or use the project tempo.
  3. Result: check the notes, then listen or add them to the project.
  • Instrument: choose from guitars, Turkish and world instruments, keys, winds, strings and synths.
  • ▶ Listen with this instrument and ▶ Listen to original let you compare.
  • Add to arrangement: creates a track. It can also add the original audio, muted.
  • Outputs: view or print sheet music, Sheet music (XML), MIDI, Guitar tab, Bass tab, Note list (Do Re Mi), or everything as a report.
  • Riffs: repeating riffs are listed when found.
Melody mode is the most accurate, for one instrument or voice. On a full song the result is approximate: the main melody and chords are found, but separate instruments cannot be pulled apart.

10. Amp Rack tab

Getting sound

  1. Connect your instrument. See chapter 15.
  2. Press ⏻ Start Rack and allow the microphone.
  3. Choose the Input channel: Input 1, Input 2 or Stereo.
  4. Pick a preset from "Choose preset…".

Top controls

ControlFunction
RoutingSingle path, 2-way splitter, 3-way splitter (wet/dry/wet) or Parallel stereo (2 inputs).
Input, OutputInput and output level of the rack.
Tuner, A4, Silent tuningTuner display, reference pitch, and muting the output while you tune.
Save RigSaves the whole chain as a preset.
Copy to selected audio trackPuts the chain on a track, so you can record through it.
Live modeA preset view for playing live. MIDI Program Change can switch presets.
Cab linkSelects a matching cab when the amp changes.
Bypass all cabinetsFor when you use an external IR or cabinet.
TAPSets the project tempo. Delays and modulators follow it.

The signal chain

  • At input: devices before the split, for example a gate or compressor.
  • Path: one row per path, with its own Level, Pan, M, S and Ø (invert phase).
  • DI (direct signal) path: adds the dry signal in parallel.
  • Master bus (post FX): devices after all paths.
  • + Pedal / Effect / Amp: adds a device. The ◀ ▶ arrows, or dragging, change the order.

Amp and cab

Amp Head: choose a model and set Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble, Presence and Master. Amps are named by style:

  • Clean: Clean, Bright Clean, Clean Reverb, Clean Jazz.
  • Crunch: Crunch, Classic Crunch, Bright Crunch, Vintage Combo, Warm Combo, Soft Overdrive.
  • Lead: Lead, Smooth Lead, Hard Rock.
  • Metal: High Gain, Modern Hi-Gain, Heavy Metal, Tight Metal, Modern Metal.
  • Bass: Bass Tube, Bass Modern, Bass Classic, Bass Hi-Fi, Bass Overdrive.

Cabinet Simulator: choose a cabinet and place up to two microphones (position, distance, angle, pan, level, type and polarity). To use your own cabinet response, press Load IR… with a WAV file and turn on Use IR.

Modulators

+ Modulator connects an LFO, envelope follower or step sequencer to any knob in the chain, such as wah, amp gain or delay mix. They can follow the tempo.

Mixer column

  • Each channel: Trim; Treble, Mid and Bass with KILL; Filter and its Res; FX A and FX B sends; channel fader and meter.
  • MIC: switch, Volume, Echo and Talkover, which lowers the music while you talk.
  • Send A · Dub Delay: frequency band, time, Feedback and Return.
  • Send B: reverb type (Shimmer, Spring or Hall), frequency band and Return.
  • Crossfader: blends A and B, with a Smooth or Sharp curve.
  • EQ: 3-band or 4-band isolator.
  • Fader: Linear, Rotary or Fast cut.
  • Smart transition A→B, B→A: matches the tempo, starts on the bar and crossfades with a bass swap, over 8 to 64 beats.
  • Master level and master effect (M.FX).
  • ● Record Set: records your mix as WAV or compressed.

Pad modes

Each deck has eight pads. The menu to their left chooses what they do. With a pad Shift function, hold Shift or use the SHIFT button.

ModeFunction
Hot Cue, Hot Cue 9-16Click to set or jump. Shift + click deletes.
Loop RollA short loop while held. The track continues underneath.
SlicerSplits the current bar into 8 slices. The held slice repeats.
Beat JumpJumps by a number of beats.
Loop, Loop+Loops by length; Loop+ runs from 1/32 to 128 beats.
Cue LoopStarts a loop from a cue point.
Key CuePlays from hot cue 1 in the chosen key.
Stems, Stem + FXTurns stems on and off, or sends them to effects.
Manual Loop, Saved LoopLoop in and out by hand; stored loops.
Remix PointsSection starts found automatically.
ScratchEight ready scratch patterns. The track continues underneath.

Sampler

Sixteen pads per bank, with as many banks as you need ("+ New bank…"). Load a sound onto a pad, and choose its trigger mode: On/Off, Stutter, Hold, Loop or Unmute. Output goes to the master or a deck. ● Record to pad records 4 to 32 beats from the master or a deck.

Library

  • + Add tracks: adds files. Tags and covers are read automatically. BPM and key are saved the first time a track loads to a deck.
  • Filters: playlist, compatible key, BPM range and text search.
  • Sort: name, artist, BPM, key, rating or date added.
  • Each track: → A and → B load it; 🎧 prelistens; ℹ edits its information and rating; "+⏵" adds it to the Automix queue; ♫ adds it to a playlist; ✕ removes it.
  • Import: DJ Library XML, DJ Collection NML or M3U, including BPM, key, beat grid, hot cues and playlists.
  • Export ▾: DJ Library XML, or M3U8 for the whole library.
Tracks are stored inside the app. Removing one from the library does not delete your original file.

Automix and History

Automix plays the queue by itself, using Smart (beat-matched), Fade or Cut transitions over 8 to 32 beats. "Remove played" takes finished tracks out of the queue, and Shuffle reorders it.

History lists the tracks you played. It can be downloaded as text or cleared.

Video Engine

If a deck holds a video file (MP4, WebM), its picture plays in sync with the sound. Tracks without video show the cover and a visualizer.

  • Source: Deck picture, Visualizer, Camera or Slideshow.
  • Visual: Bars, Wave or Ring.
  • Transition: Fade, Wipe or Zoom.
  • Video crossfader: Smart, Linked to crossfader, or Manual.
  • Output window: move it to a second screen and double-click for full screen.

It uses no CPU while Video is off.

Controller Center

  • Connected devices: what the app sees now.
  • Start mapping wizard: asks you to move each control in turn and saves a profile per device.
  • Add HID device (experimental): for models that use only their own protocol. Lights and high-resolution jog do not work on this path.
  • Back to ready mapping: appears for recognised devices and undoes your changes.
  • Jog / encoder format: Auto works for most devices.
  • Jog sensitivity: for a jog that feels too fast or too slow.
  • Tempo fader direction: Tick Reverse if the fader runs backwards.
  • Assign a control: touch a control on your device and choose its command.
  • Soft takeover: a fader has no effect until it reaches the value on screen, so the sound does not jump.
  • Live signal: shows what your device is sending.

Computer keyboard in the DJ Mixer

KeyFunction
Space / EnterDeck A / B play or pause
1 … 8Deck A pads
Q … IDeck B pads

Not included: broadcasting, timecode vinyl, light control (DMX) and external audio plugins. Ready mappings cover common models only; other devices are mapped once with the wizard. The DJ Mixer has not been tested with every controller on real hardware.

12. East·West·Afro tab

Microtonal Tuning

  • TUNING ON: every instrument plays in the selected maqam or scale.
  • System: Turkish Maqams (53 koma), Arabic Maqams (quarter tone), African Scales or Western.
  • Maqam / scale, Tonic (durak), A4 (Hz): the scale, its base note and the reference pitch.
  • Maqam lock: keys outside the maqam snap to the nearest degree.
  • Apply to MIDI tools: sets the same scale in Mini Tools.
  • Load tuning file (.scl)…: uses your own tuning.

Turkish maqams use the 53-koma model, where one koma is about 22.64 cents. The keys show each note's offset in cents. Press a key to hear it.

Polyrhythmic Usul & Afro-Groove Sequencer

Each lane has its own step count (#) and loop length (⟲), so a 4/4 kick, a 9/8 aksak usul and a 3:2 cross-rhythm play together without drifting. Sound comes from a "Groove · World Percussion" track, where it can be mixed and recorded.

  • Pattern: presets such as Afro House, Amapiano, Son Clave, Aksak 9/8, Curcuna 10/8 and Çiftetelli.
  • Swing, Humanize (ms), Humanize (vel).
  • + Lane: adds a lane. R: rolls during the Tension macro. M: mutes the lane.
  • Write to arrangement…: writes 1 to 16 bars.

Live Drone & Atmosphere

A continuous drone or nature sound for long transitions: Ney, Tambur / Tanpura, Analog Pad, Afro Forest, Wind, Rain or Tribal Choir. If you choose a DJ deck as "Key source", the drone locks to that track's detected key.

Tension / Build-Up Macro

One knob raises tension: groove lanes marked R roll and harden, the filters of playing DJ decks open, and riser noise and drone rise. DROP resets everything on the next bar with an impact. Right-click the knob to link it to a MIDI knob.

13. Metal Creative tab

MRH Riff Factory

Choose Style (8), Tune (9, where ★ marks those recommended for the style), Section (8) and BPM. Each combination gives 40 chunks of 2 bars. Guitar, bass, drums, synth and FX are generated together, and the kick follows the guitar.

  • ▶ previews a chunk. + Song adds it to the Song Workshop. ⇣ Project writes it at the playhead.
  • Download DI pack: a ZIP of 20 chunks with DI guitar and bass WAVs and MIDI files. "Download DI + amped pack" adds amped guitars, and "Full pack" makes 40 chunks.

DGN Song Workshop

Choose a Structure and press 🎲 Random song, or add chunks by hand. Each row sets the chunk number and repeats, with buttons to preview, move and remove.

  • Write to project (multitrack): creates tracks starting with "MC ·": Guitar L and R, Bass, Drums, Lead, Clean Guitar, Synth and Industrial FX. It also sets the tempo and loop.
  • Download as MIDI (.zip).

Everything is MIDI, so riffs, tones and drums can be changed later. Guitar and bass notes with velocity 100 or below are palm-muted; higher notes ring open.

Mr. Mars Metal Tone Archive

97 ready amp and cab tones, plus genre packs. Each is a full chain: noise gate, DI Booster, tightening overdrive, amp, cab and EQ. Search the list, then choose "Apply to selected track", "New guitar track" or "Apply to MC guitars".

Metal Tools

  • DI Booster: used before the amp. Body, Deep Octave, String Shine, Saw Distortion, Metal Ring and Squash.
  • Drum Fist: Hit, Grit, 3-band Transient, Boom 100 Hz, Air 8 kHz and parallel Mix.
  • Instruments: Metal Guitar DI (7/8-string), Metal Bass (5-string), Metal Drum Kit and the 90-sound Industrial Destruction FX.
  • MRH Metal Synth Presets: also listed as "MC ›" in the Digital Mini Synth.
  • Metal Mix Template: drums, double guitars, bass, lead, clean guitar, synth, FX, vocal chain, reverb and delay returns, and master processing. "Template + example song" also writes a song.
Riffs are generated by rules, not recorded performances. Treat them as a starting point and edit them in the piano roll.

14. Plugins tab

This tab lists every device with its parameter count and source. New effects and instruments are added as plugins. A loaded plugin can be used on every track, in the mixer and in Amp Rack.

Adding a plugin

  1. Load Plugin (.js)… stores it in the app's portable profile.
  2. Or put the .js file into the mrmars-eklentiler folder and add its name to mrmars-eklentiler/index.js.

For writing your own, see Download plugin template and API Docs. Plugins register with MrMars.register({ ... }). The files rotary-hoparlor.js and telefon-efekti.js are examples.

Only load plugin files you trust. A plugin is code that runs inside the app. External audio plugin formats cannot be loaded.

15. Connecting devices

Use Edge or Chrome on Windows and Mac. Plug the device in; there is no setup program. The browser asks for permission the first time, so choose Allow. The "MIDI:" line at the bottom left shows what the app sees.

MIDI keyboard

It is recognised automatically, and notes play the selected instrument straight away.

DJ controller

Common models are recognised when plugged in, and a ready mapping loads by itself. You can start playing straight away.

Other models are mapped once:

  1. Plug it in. A banner offers Map, Not now and Don't ask again.
  2. Map opens the wizard. Move each control when asked, and skip what your device lacks.
  3. The mapping is saved as a profile for that device, and loads by itself next time.

To change any control, open DJ Mixer > Controller Center, go to "Assign a control", touch the control on your device and choose a command. "Back to ready mapping" undoes your changes.

Jog wheels: touch the top and turn to scratch; the sound follows your hand, forwards and backwards. When you let go, the track carries on from there. Turn the edge to nudge the tempo during play. This needs Vinyl on in the DJ Mixer.

Ready mappings have not been tried on every device. If something does not respond, assign it yourself or run the wizard.

Electric guitar or bass

  1. A guitar does not connect by MIDI. Plug it into the Hi-Z (instrument) input of an audio interface.
  2. Connect the interface by USB.
  3. Choose it as input and output under Tools > Audio settings.
  4. Open Amp Rack, press ⏻ and allow the microphone.
  5. Set the level on the interface's gain knob so that it does not clip.

WindowsMac

16. Audio, MIDI and export settings

Audio settings

  • Audio input and output: your interface or sound device. Your own device names appear here.
  • Recording latency compensation: if recordings land late against the backing, raise this value. Leave it empty for automatic.
  • Latency mode: Lowest, Low, Balanced or Safe. Applies after restart.
  • Sample rate: device default, or 44.1 to 96 kHz. Applies after restart.
  • Release audio when in background: frees the sound device when the app is not in use.
  • Reset / restart: restarts the audio engine.

If the sound crackles, choose Safe and run fewer amp chains at once. Browsers use the normal system audio path, not special low-latency drivers.

MIDI settings

  • MIDI inputs and outputs: the connected ports.
  • Send MIDI Clock: other programs and machines follow this app's tempo. Set the other device to "external clock".
  • Clock source: the project transport, or the playing DJ deck.
  • Follow external MIDI Clock: this app follows another device.
  • Play / stop with external Start / Stop.

Mixdown / Export

  • Bit depth: 16-bit, 24-bit or 32-bit float.
  • Sample rate.
  • Loop region only: exports only the marked region.
  • Normalize: raises the level to full scale.
  • Tail (seconds): extra time for reverbs and delays to fade.
  • Each track separately (stems): one WAV per track.
  • Audio (WAV), MIDI files.
  • Sheet music (XML + printable SVG).
  • Tab, riffs and note list (TXT).

17. Mac, phones and tablets

Mac

Double-click Mr Mars Music Studio.command. Chrome or Edge is required. If macOS blocks it the first time, right-click it and choose Open. If it says permission denied, run this once in Terminal from the app folder:

chmod +x "Mr Mars Music Studio.command"

Android, iPhone and iPad

The app must be opened from its web address, once, while online. Then add it to the home screen:

  • Android: Tools > "Add to home screen".
  • iPhone or iPad: Safari > Share > "Add to Home Screen".

It then opens offline too. Projects stay in that device's browser, so export a .mrmars file to move them.

Touch controls

  • Press and drag moves controls.
  • Long press acts as right-click.
  • Double tap resets a knob.
  • ☰ and 🎹 open the panel and keyboard on narrow screens.
  • SHIFT in the DJ Mixer gives pads their second function.

Limits

  • MIDI works on Android in Chrome with USB OTG. No browser on iPhone or iPad has MIDI.
  • Phones have less CPU and memory. Several amp chains, stem separation and long tracks can be too heavy.
  • The iPhone silent switch can mute the sound.
  • Some devices cannot decode formats such as FLAC or OGG.
  • A separate headphone output is rarely available, so use "Split" mode.
Mac, Android and iOS support has not been tested on every real device.

  • Z / X: octave down or up
  • C / V: velocity down or up

The DJ Mixer has its own keys. See Controller Center.

19. Files, backup and moving

Moving to another computer

Copy the whole "Mr Mars Music Studio All in 1" folder to a USB drive. Projects, recordings, settings and installed plugins live in the veri folder inside it. This applies when you start the app with its launcher.

Backup and sharing

File > Export project file (.mrmars) creates one complete file with the project and its audio. This is the safest backup. Keep copies outside the app folder.

20. Troubleshooting and known limits

ProblemWhat to do
"MIDI: no permission"Allow MIDI in the site permissions (the padlock in the address bar), then reload.
"MIDI: no device"Try another USB port or cable, close other music programs, and reload.
"MIDI: not supported"Switch to Edge or Chrome.
No signal in the mapping wizardSome devices use HID rather than MIDI. Try "Add HID device (experimental)" in Controller Center. Some models first need the maker's driver or switching to a MIDI mode.
No guitar soundCheck the input in Audio settings, the microphone permission and the interface gain. Check that ⏻ Start Rack is on.
Crackling soundChoose Safe under Audio settings > Latency mode and restart. Run fewer amp chains at once.
Recordings are lateRaise "Recording latency compensation" in Audio settings.
Interface in the wrong languageUse the 🌐 button beside the menus.

Known limits

  • The app uses the browser's audio engine. External audio plugins and special audio drivers are not used; it is extended with its own plugin system.
  • Stem separation and audio-to-notes use signal processing, so results are approximate.
  • Metal Creative riffs are rule-based, not recorded performances.
  • There is no true sidechain. The Pump effect does tempo-locked ducking.
  • There is no automation on the master channel or the Amp Rack.
